research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Cohesity is researching and developing technologies for efficient backup, restore, and management of data across distributed and cloud environments. Efforts include distributed journals for high performance continuous data protection, adaptive deduplication, parallelization of incremental backups, efficient data retrieval using embeddings, and snapshot archive management. Additional focus areas are anomaly detection before backup, hierarchical storage management, and secure communications for storage tenants, highlighting advancements in data protection, storage optimization, and analytics.

about_short_description.short_description: Cohesity is a data management technology firm that offers hyper-converged secondary storage solutions for backups, files, and analytics.

product.name: Cohesity Data Cloud
product.description: A unified data management platform for protecting, securing, recovering, and analyzing enterprise data across on-premises, cloud, and SaaS environments.

product.name: Cohesity DataProtect
product.description: A backup and recovery solution for protecting workloads across on-premises, hybrid-cloud, multicloud, and SaaS environments.

product.name: NetBackup
product.description: An enterprise backup and recovery product for protecting data across physical, virtual, cloud, SaaS, and application environments.

product.name: Cohesity FortKnox
product.description: A cloud-based cyber vaulting service that stores isolated, immutable copies of enterprise data for recovery after cyberattacks or disasters.

product.name: Cohesity SmartFiles
product.description: A scale-out file and object data service for consolidating file shares, archives, backups, and other unstructured data on a unified platform.

product.name: Cohesity Alta SaaS Protection
product.description: A SaaS data protection service for backing up and recovering cloud applications such as Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Salesforce, and Slack.
